# EU AI Act dataset

> Obligations, application dates, Annex III use cases, prohibited practices and fines of the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) as amended by the Digital Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744). Structured data in JSON, YAML and iCalendar, English and German. Licence CC BY 4.0. Published by SimpleAct UG (haftungsbeschränkt), Recklinghausen, Germany.

Key dates: prohibitions and AI literacy since 2 Feb 2025; general-purpose AI models since 2 Aug 2025; transparency under Art. 50 since 2 Aug 2026; high-risk AI under Annex III from 2 Dec 2027; high-risk AI in Annex I products from 2 Aug 2028.

## Data

- [Obligations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SimpleAct-Compliance/eu-ai-act-dataset/main/data/obligations.json): 33 obligations with article, role and application date
- [Application dates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SimpleAct-Compliance/eu-ai-act-dataset/main/data/deadlines.json): 10 dates from 2024 to 2030
- [Annex III](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SimpleAct-Compliance/eu-ai-act-dataset/main/data/annex-iii.json): 8 areas, 25 high-risk use cases
- [Prohibited practices](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SimpleAct-Compliance/eu-ai-act-dataset/main/data/prohibited-practices.json): Article 5
- [Fines](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SimpleAct-Compliance/eu-ai-act-dataset/main/data/fines.json): Article 99
